description:
Use this when the user wants to know when to post: "best time to post on TikTok", "when should I upload my
        Shorts", "which day gets me the most views". Answers from the user's own posts, not general advice: average
        views 24 hours after posting by weekday and 4-hour block. timezone: an IANA name such as America/Chicago
        (default UTC). platform: one platform or all. Needs 5 posted posts that have a day of views; below that it says
        how many there are and how to test. An estimate from past posts.
        Not for: drafting posts at those times (plan_posts), scheduling one post (draft_post) or a full recap
        (weekly_report). Free and read only; it schedules nothing.
name: best_time_to_post
title: Best time to post
